say:0:1631222001:1.text: Under the rising heat, the snowman melts in an instant, leaving only a small puddle.
say:0:1631222001:1.source_cn: 在高温的催促下，小雪人瞬间融化，只留下一小摊水迹。
say:0:1631222001:1.male: Under the rising heat, the snowman melts in an instant, leaving only a small puddle.
say:0:1631222001:1.female: Under the rising heat, the snowman melts in an instant, leaving only a small puddle.

say:2:1631222002:0.text: A moment later, a soaked parrot appears, shaking off water violently.
say:2:1631222002:0.source_cn: 下一秒，一只羽毛湿漉漉的鹦鹉出现，它高速抖动着身上的积...
say:2:1631222002:0.male: A moment later, a soaked parrot appears, shaking off water violently.
say:2:1631222002:0.female: A moment later, a soaked parrot appears, shaking off water violently.

say:3:1631222003:1.text: A-achoo! I'm saved! Using fire to melt ice... clever! Very clever! Thanks!
say:3:1631222003:1.source_cn: 阿——阿嚏！得、得救了！你这招以火融冰……聪明！真聪明...
say:3:1631222003:1.male: A-achoo! I'm saved! Using fire to melt ice... clever! Very clever! Thanks!
say:3:1631222003:1.female: A-achoo! I'm saved! Using fire to melt ice... clever! Very clever! Thanks!

say:4:1631222004:1.text: But it's hot! Too hot! My feathers are about to curl! I need shade, now!
say:4:1631222004:1.source_cn: 但是这里！烫！烫脚！不行不行，羽毛都快烤卷了……我得找...
say:4:1631222004:1.male: But it's hot! Too hot! My feathers are about to curl! I need shade, now!
say:4:1631222004:1.female: But it's hot! Too hot! My feathers are about to curl! I need shade, now!

say:5:1631222005:1.text: Next time... let's meet somewhere cool! I'll treat you to the tastiest fruit, I promise!
say:5:1631222005:1.source_cn: 下次见面……找个凉快地方！请你吃……呃……最好吃的果子...
say:5:1631222005:1.male: Next time... let's meet somewhere cool! I'll treat you to the tastiest fruit, I promise!
say:5:1631222005:1.female: Next time... let's meet somewhere cool! I'll treat you to the tastiest fruit, I promise!

narration:7:1631222006:0.text: Before you can reply, the parrot flaps away in a blur.
narration:7:1631222006:0.source_cn: 话音未落，这只鹦鹉便振翅一溜烟飞走了。
narration:7:1631222006:0.male: Before you can reply, the parrot flaps away in a blur.
narration:7:1631222006:0.female: Before you can reply, the parrot flaps away in a blur.
